package decodertest

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/decodertest/apigen"
	shared "example.com/decodertest/shared"
	"example.com/decodertest/taskgen"
	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3"
)

func requests() map[string]func() any {
	return map[string]func() any{
		"openapi": func() any { return new(apigen.Request) },
		"shared":  func() any { return new(shared.Request) },
		"task":    func() any { return new(taskgen.SubmitParameters) },
	}
}

func field(value any, name string) reflect.Value {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(value).Elem()
	for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
		if strings.Split(v.Type().Field(i).Tag.Get("json"), ",")[0] == name {
			return v.Field(i)
		}
	}
	panic(name)
}

func TestNumbersAndStrings(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		input string
		want  int64
	}{
		{`0`, 0}, {`"0"`, 0}, {`123`, 123}, {`"123"`, 123},
		{`-123`, -123}, {`"-123"`, -123}, {`"+00123"`, 123}, {`"\u0031\u0032\u0033"`, 123},
		{`9007199254740993`, 9007199254740993}, {`"9007199254740993"`, 9007199254740993},
		{`9223372036854775807`, math.MaxInt64}, {`"9223372036854775807"`, math.MaxInt64},
		{`-9223372036854775808`, math.MinInt64}, {`"-9223372036854775808"`, math.MinInt64},
		{`123.0`, 123}, {`1.23e2`, 123}, {`9223372036854775807.0`, math.MaxInt64},
		{`0e99999999999999999999999999`, 0},
	}
	for generator, newRequest := range requests() {
		for _, tc := range cases {
			t.Run(generator+"/"+tc.input, func(t *testing.T) {
				value := newRequest()
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":`+tc.input+`,"device_key":`+tc.input+`}`), value); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				required, optional := field(value, "required_key"), field(value, "device_key")
				if required.Type() != reflect.TypeOf(int64(0)) || optional.Type() != reflect.TypeOf((*int64)(nil)) {
					t.Fatalf("wrong public types: %v, %v", required.Type(), optional.Type())
				}
				if required.Int() != tc.want || optional.IsNil() || optional.Elem().Int() != tc.want {
					t.Fatalf("lost integer value: %+v", value)
				}
				encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var wire map[string]json.RawMessage
				if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &wire); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if string(wire["device_key"]) != fmt.Sprint(tc.want) {
					t.Fatalf("expected numeric output, got %s", encoded)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestPresenceAndInvalidValues(t *testing.T) {
	invalid := []string{
		`"abc"`, `""`, `" 123 "`, `"1.5"`, `"1e3"`, `1.5`, `1e-1`, `true`, `{}`, `[]`, `null`,
		`9223372036854775808`, `-9223372036854775809`, `"9223372036854775808"`,
		`9007199254740993.1`, `1e99999999999999999`, `1e-99999999999999999`,
	}
	for generator, newRequest := range requests() {
		t.Run(generator, func(t *testing.T) {
			value := newRequest()
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":0}`), value); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !field(value, "device_key").IsNil() {
				t.Fatal("omitted optional field must be nil")
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, newRequest()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("cannot decode serialized optional fields: %s: %v", encoded, err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":0,"nullable_key":null}`), value); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !field(value, "nullable_key").IsNil() {
				t.Fatal("nullable field must be nil")
			}
			for _, input := range invalid {
				value := newRequest()
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":0,"device_key":`+input+`}`), value); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "device_key") {
					t.Errorf("expected field error for %s, got %v", input, err)
				}
			}
			for _, input := range []string{`{}`, `null`, `{"required_key":null}`, `{"required_key":0,"plain_int":"123"}`, `{"required_key":0,"DEVICE_KEY":true}`, `{"required_key":0,"device_key":1,"DEVICE_KEY":2}`} {
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), newRequest()); err == nil {
					t.Errorf("accepted %s", input)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReferencesArraysAndOriginalBranchConstraints(t *testing.T) {
	for generator, newRequest := range requests() {
		t.Run(generator, func(t *testing.T) {
			value := newRequest()
			input := `{"required_key":1,"key_ref":"012","key_alias":"9223372036854775807","child":{"key":"012","next":{"key":"013"}},"keys":["9223372036854775807",1],"inline_keys":["9007199254740993",2]}`
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), value); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if field(value, "key_ref").Elem().Int() != 12 {
				t.Fatal("incorrect referenced conversion")
			}
			if field(value, "key_alias").Elem().Int() != math.MaxInt64 {
				t.Fatal("incorrect alias conversion")
			}
			if reflect.Indirect(field(value, "keys")).Index(0).Int() != math.MaxInt64 {
				t.Fatal("lost referenced array value")
			}
			if reflect.Indirect(field(value, "inline_keys")).Index(0).Int() != 9007199254740993 {
				t.Fatal("lost inline array value")
			}
			for _, input := range []string{
				`{"required_key":0,"key_ref":12}`,
				`{"required_key":0,"key_ref":"12"}`,
				`{"required_key":0,"child":{}}`,
				`{"required_key":0,"child":{"key":"012","next":null}}`,
				`{"required_key":0,"keys":[null]}`,
				`{"required_key":0,"inline_keys":["bad"]}`,
			} {
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), newRequest()); err == nil {
					t.Errorf("accepted %s", input)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	var nested taskgen.SubmitParameters
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":0,"inline_child":{"key":"012"}}`), &nested); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var external apigen.ExternalRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"request":{"required_key":"9223372036854775807"}}`), &external); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if external.Request.RequiredKey != math.MaxInt64 {
		t.Fatal("external schema lost precision")
	}
}

func TestRootModelsAndUnchangedPlainTypes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, dst := range []any{new(apigen.Key), new(shared.Key), new(apigen.KeyAlias), new(shared.KeyAlias), new(taskgen.ScalarParameters)} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"9223372036854775807"`), dst); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if reflect.ValueOf(dst).Elem().Int() != math.MaxInt64 {
			t.Fatal("incorrect scalar")
		}
	}
	for _, dst := range []any{new(apigen.Keys), new(shared.Keys), new(taskgen.ArrayParameters)} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`["9223372036854775807",1]`), dst); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if reflect.ValueOf(dst).Elem().Index(0).Int() != math.MaxInt64 {
			t.Fatal("incorrect array")
		}
	}
	for _, dst := range []any{new(apigen.Plain), new(shared.Plain)} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"key":"123"}`), dst); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("unannotated field gained coercion")
		}
	}
}

func TestTaskPayloadRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	var params taskgen.SubmitParameters
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"required_key":"9223372036854775807"}`), &params); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	task, err := taskgen.NewSubmitTask(&params)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var decoded taskgen.SubmitParameters
	if err := json.Unmarshal(task.Spec.Payload, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if field(&decoded, "required_key").Int() != math.MaxInt64 || !field(&decoded, "device_key").IsNil() {
		t.Fatal("task round trip lost value or presence")
	}
}

type handler struct{}

func (handler) CreateDevice(c fiber.Ctx) error {
	var request apigen.Request
	if err := c.Bind().Body(&request); err != nil {
		return fiber.NewError(fiber.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
	}
	return c.JSON(request)
}

func TestFiberJSONBinding(t *testing.T) {
	app := fiber.New()
	apigen.RegisterHandlers(app, handler{})
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		body   string
		status int
	}{
		{`{"required_key":"9223372036854775807","device_key":"0"}`, 200},
		{`{"required_key":0}`, 200},
		{`{"required_key":"abc"}`, 400},
		{`{"required_key":0,"device_key":null}`, 400},
		{`{}`, 400},
	} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/devices", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		res, err := app.Test(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res.Body.Close()
		if res.StatusCode != tc.status {
			t.Errorf("%s: status %d, want %d", tc.body, res.StatusCode, tc.status)
		}
	}
}
